feeds.title: Bang2Write
feeds.description: Hattie shares writing craft and networking tips for screenwriters and novelists. She is a script editor, author & blogger.

feeds.title: Ari Meghlen
feeds.description: Tips, tricks, and tutorials for writers and authors. This blog is where I share my thoughts and techniques on the many aspects of writing.

feeds.title: Pick Up Your Pen
feeds.description: Covers tips on all aspects of writing, productivity, habits and different ways of marketing yourself and your writing.

feeds.title: Robin Hawdon Blog
feeds.description: Robin Hawdon has written some of the theatre's most popular comedies. Over the last decade there have been productions in major theatres in New York, Chicago, Paris, Berlin, Bonn, Tel Aviv, Warsaw, and many more.

feeds.title: Paige Briscoe Blog
feeds.description: Paige Briscoe is a blogger, student, and writer. In this blog, she shares her thoughts on books through reviews, gives insight to the world through lifestyle blog posts, and showcase her own creative writing.

feeds.title: Be a Freelance Blogger
feeds.description: Be a Freelance Blogger shares useful resources, valuable tips and guest posting opportunities for bloggers looking to earn a living from writing. Learn how to find paid blogging jobs and enjoy your freedom as a freelance blogger - whether you want to stay home with your family or travel the world

feeds.title: Amanda Read
feeds.description: I'm a writer, reader and reviewer of books and writerly events. I'll be sharing tips and tools to improve your writing, looking at literary genres of interest, and recommending books in those genres.

feeds.title: The Creative Penn Blog
feeds.description: I'm Joanna. I love books and since you're here, I guess you do too! This site is for writers just starting out in need of craft advice, as well as for authors further ahead on the journey looking for business help and a glimpse into the future of creativity.I've been sharing my writing and publishing experience since 2008 so you can learn from my mistakes and be more successful in your creative life.

feeds.title: Poem Stellium
feeds.description: Discover the work of writers, poets, bloggers, and more. Each piece carries vulnerability and how they all contribute to the Poem Stellium. You are sure to be touched by their words and learn something whilst you read. You'll also discover writing tips and more.

feeds.title: Curtis Brown Creative Blog
feeds.description: Curtis Brown Creative blog is a place for writers to get information on the latest happenings at Curtis Brown Creative, writing tips and advice from literary agents.

feeds.title: Christopher Fowler
feeds.description: The official Blog of Christopher Fowler, the multi-award-winning author of over thirty novels and twelve short story collections.

feeds.title: Watermill blog » Writing Courses
feeds.description: The Watermill at Posara is the ideal place for an inspirational writing course. Set in a beautiful valley in Lunigiana, Tuscany's unspoilt corner, the mill provides the perfect environment for focusing on your writing without the distractions of everyday life. Our sympathetic tutors will share with you the secrets of writing success and what publishers are looking for. And after a hard day's work you can slip into holiday mode with wonderful food, good company and relaxing surroundings.
